reviews.comment: Class was difficult for me as I'm not naturally good at mathematics but he never made me feel bad about it, always willing to help in office hours. I think he is a great professor for those who are interested in math, I also admit I probably should have enrolled in 152 rather than 172 but his lectures made it so even I could understand something.

First math teacher that made me feel that A&M deserved its rating as a good university. His tests are very hard, and the class itself requires a lot of time commitment. I would recommend going to math help, once or twice a week. The professor is relatively understanding, and accessible out of the classroom.

Dr. Demlow is a great guy, and his lectures were entertaining. There's a few assignments every week, along with quizzes in recitation, 3 midterms, and a final. The class wasn't overly demanding, and he made calc 2 feel approachable. He has review lectures and extended office hours before exams, along with less HW during exam weeks and past exams.

Ignore that previous review; it's fake. This professor is only here for research, he doesn't really care about the fate of his students. Made us pay ALOT of money to access our homework. Test scores were much lower than 80%, on average. Sample questions for exams are insufficient, exams are unpredictable. Told use to ChatGPT any questions we have.

Cares a lot and is a great lecturer, hw and quiz every week but very doable. Tests are 10 frq questions but he gives a review and the questions are predictible, also very generous partial credit for exams, test scores were ~80 and if it was lower he would curve to be near. Is also open to question during lecture. I recommend
